objective:
Let a semantic-corpus case accept specific existing activities as correct alternatives, and apply the owner's review of the first device run (2026-09-18).

BACKGROUND: The corpus (`core-testing/src/main/resources/semantic-corpus/corpus.json`, 48 cases) is replayed by `SemanticReplay` (core-testing/src/main/kotlin/com/mcfrenchpants/activityledger/core/testing/corpus/SemanticReplay.kt). When a recorded answer is auto-accepted to an existing catalog activity, the scorer currently flags `MATCHED_EXISTING_WHEN_NEW_EXPECTED` if `expected.activityId == null`, or `WRONG_EXISTING_ACTIVITY` if it differs from `expected.activityId`. The owner reviewed the device results and ruled three matches acceptable: 'Washed the car.' -> act-wax-car, 'Emptied the dryer lint trap.' -> act-clean-dryer-vent, 'Cleaned the dryer.' -> act-clean-dryer-vent. The corpus rule stands that expectations are the correct PRODUCT behaviour; the owner is the authority on that.

DO:
1. `CorpusModel.kt` `ExpectedInterpretation`: add a REQUIRED (no default, like every other field there) property `allowedActivityIds: List<String>` = other existing catalog ids that are equally acceptable matches. KDoc it in the same style. Add a convenience `acceptableActivityIds: Set<String>` = `setOfNotNull(activityId) + allowedActivityIds`.
2. `corpus.json`: add `"allowedActivityIds": []` to every case's `expected` (place it right after `activityId`). Keep the file LF-only and in its existing formatting style. Then change exactly three cases:
   a. `car-washed-the-car`: allowedResolutions ["EXISTING_ACTIVITY"], allowedActivityIds ["act-wax-car"], remove act-wax-car from mustNotMatch, update the note: owner 2026-09-18 accepts Wax car as a match (washing and waxing the car logged as one activity); a new 'Wash car' activity is also correct.
   b. `dryer-emptied-the-lint-trap`: allowedResolutions ["EXISTING_ACTIVITY"], allowedActivityIds ["act-clean-dryer-vent"], remove act-clean-dryer-vent from mustNotMatch, update note likewise (owner accepts Clean dryer vent; a new lint-trap activity is also correct).
   c. `dryer-generic-cleaned-the-dryer` (keep the id): owner accepts Clean dryer vent for this generic sentence, so it is no longer an AMBIGUITY case. Make it category SYNONYM, resolution EXISTING_ACTIVITY, activityId "act-clean-dryer-vent", allowedResolutions ["AMBIGUOUS", "UNRESOLVED"] (asking the user is still acceptable -- that scores as a safe miss), allowedActivityIds [], mustNotMatch [], allowedStates ["COMPLETED"], outcome AUTO_ACCEPT, other fields consistent with the integrity rules; update the note.
   Do not change any other case. `ambiguous-did-the-furnace-thing` and the edging/raking/water-heater/smoke-detector cases stay exactly as they are.
3. `SemanticReplay.kt` scorer: for an auto-accepted occurrence whose activity is in the catalog, it is acceptable iff it is in `expected.acceptableActivityIds`; otherwise keep the existing flags (`MATCHED_EXISTING_WHEN_NEW_EXPECTED` when `expected.activityId == null`, else `WRONG_EXISTING_ACTIVITY`). A newly created activity keeps its current name checks (`DUPLICATE_NEW_ACTIVITY` only when `expected.activityId != null`, i.e. do not flag a new activity as duplicate merely because allowedActivityIds is non-empty; `WRONG_NEW_NAME` unchanged). mustNotMatch, state, date and precision checks unchanged. No domain rule re-implemented; the real orchestrator still decides the outcome.
4. `CorpusIntegrityTest.kt`: add checks: every allowedActivityIds entry exists in the case's catalog; none is in mustNotMatch; none equals activityId; no duplicates; non-empty allowedActivityIds requires EXISTING_ACTIVITY in the acceptable resolutions and outcome AUTO_ACCEPT; AMBIGUITY cases must have empty allowedActivityIds. Keep all existing checks passing (update any pinned category counts to the new ones: SYNONYM 18, AMBIGUITY 4; total stays 48).
5. `SemanticReplayScorerTest.kt`: add synthetic-recording tests: (i) a case with allowedActivityIds auto-accepted to the allowed id scores CORRECT; (ii) same case auto-accepted to a different catalog activity scores UNSAFE_MISS with MATCHED_EXISTING_WHEN_NEW_EXPECTED; (iii) same case creating a new activity with an acceptable name scores CORRECT (not DUPLICATE_NEW_ACTIVITY). Follow the existing test file's patterns and any synthetic corpus/recording helpers it already uses. If the existing tests build ExpectedInterpretation directly, add the new argument there.
6. Anywhere else `ExpectedInterpretation(` is constructed in core-testing (main or test), add the new argument.
7. `docs/SEMANTIC_CORPUS.md`: add `expected.allowedActivityIds` to the case-fields table (section 4-ish, next to activityId), update the category counts in section 3 (SYNONYM 18, AMBIGUITY 4; expectations: 44 auto-accept, 4 review -- verify by counting), and add one sentence under 'The corpus hash and stale recordings' noting that an expectations-only change (no sentence, catalog or context change) keeps each case's shortlist, so an existing recording still replays and is re-scored; it is reported as `corpus matches: NO` until re-recorded. Verify that last claim against SemanticReplay's refusal logic before writing it; if it is not true, say so in your report instead of writing it.
